# Request Eagle

> Request Eagle is a native API client for macOS, Windows and Linux, written in Rust and rendered on the GPU. It is a Postman alternative that keeps requests as TOML files on disk and in Git, with scripts, Vim mode, an agent panel for Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode, and a CLI for agents.

## Pages

- [Landing](https://requesteagle.tokarev.work/): What Request Eagle is and what it can do
- [Download](https://requesteagle.tokarev.work/downloads/): The latest stable release for Apple Silicon Macs, Windows, and Debian or Ubuntu

## Guides

- [Scripting guide](https://github.com/gregor-tokarev/request-eagle/blob/main/docs/scripting.md): Pre-request and post-response JavaScript
- [Agent guide](https://github.com/gregor-tokarev/request-eagle/blob/main/docs/agent.md): The agent panel for Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode
- [Git guide](https://github.com/gregor-tokarev/request-eagle/blob/main/docs/git.md): Commit, pull, push and sync collections
- [CLI guide](https://github.com/gregor-tokarev/request-eagle/blob/main/docs/cli.md): The command-line interface for agents
- [Source code](https://github.com/gregor-tokarev/request-eagle): The repository on GitHub
